changes.evidence: The Punisher S1 episode 3 ('Kandahar') flashback: Major Schoonover co-founds and commands the Cerberus Squad with Rawlins ('This is Operation Cerberus, and you are my dogs of war'); after the Kandahar ambush the operation is shut down and the squad demobilized, and he stays a Marine (promoted to Colonel, still a USMC colonel in Daredevil S2). Past group shown on screen and missing; same group name the dataset uses for Russo and Rawlins.

Luke Cage S2 episode 1 ('Soul Brother #1'): the Rivals are named on screen as 'Shades, Comanche, and Romeo's old crew' (Bobby Fish), and Shades greets Comanche with the Rivals call ('Rivals?' 'We ain't got none'); episode 13 shows his photo of the three as Rivals. A past gang before his work for Cottonmouth, missing from the record. Keyed to the season that tells it, placed first like other flashback stages; the Luke Cage S2 left stays.
